traits.name: Uplift Aura
traits.text:
All allies within 30 feet gain +2 on
Intelligence checks and saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The dragon makes three attacks: one
with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft.,
one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft.,
one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.
